Payout of 3 July is short ₹167.39.
The bank credited ₹93,826.87 against an expected ₹93,994.26. 8 orders sit in this payout. This is consistent with refund rfnd_000030 of ₹167.38, issued 4 August against payment pay_000368. Refunds are deducted from the cycle that processes them, not the cycle of the original sale, so a payout can be reduced by a refund against a much earlier purchase.
Suggested action: verify rfnd_000030 in the refund report and confirm it was deducted from this payout. The amounts match, which is not proof of cause -- rfnd_000030 is booked to another cycle, so the link is not confirmed.
